## Blog
Index: https://shovon.bd/blog — RSS: https://shovon.bd/blog/rss.xml. Append `.md` to any post URL for plain Markdown.

### I Trained an Open Decision Model on a Free GPU in 46 Minutes. On My Tests, It Beat Laya. (Sep 24, 2026)
URL: https://shovon.bd/blog/typic-open-decision-model
- Typic (released as typic-bert on Hugging Face: https://huggingface.co/minar-svn/typic-bert) is an open decision model: given a context, a question and a list of options, it returns a calibrated probability per option in a single forward pass.
- Encoder: Ettin-400M (ModernBERT architecture). Training data: 50,000 augmented examples from 25 public datasets. Trained in 46 minutes on one free Kaggle T4 GPU.
- On 2,000 questions from four unseen tasks: Typic 69.9% overall vs Laya 56.7% (Banking77 81.2% vs 82.0%, CommonsenseQA 59.8% vs 41.6%, COPA 83.0% vs 70.2%, OpenBookQA 55.4% vs 32.8%); latency 29 ms vs 37 ms.
- With up to 7,000 tokens of unrelated text before a request, Typic kept 17–18/20 routing answers correct; Laya dropped to 5–6/20.
- Stated limits: tests chosen by the author, single training run, English-only, needs temperature scaling to match Laya's calibration.

### The Everyday Attendance Problem for Private Tutors (Oct 1, 2026)
URL: https://shovon.bd/blog/tutor-attendance-app
- Explains why attendance tracking is hard for home tutors and private teachers (scattered notebooks, spreadsheets, calendars, memory) and what a tutor attendance app should include.
- Introduces Tuition Tracker: Attendance (Android, https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.attendly.tutor): per-student monthly class-day targets, optional weekly schedules, one-tap Present/Missed, monthly calendar, Days Done / Days Left, Month-End History, WhatsApp/call Quick Connect, Google sign-in with cloud sync, light/dark mode, Android 7.0+.

### How I Built a Real-Time Commute-Time Map for Chittagong Using Next.js, Mapbox & Turf.js (May 8, 2026)
URL: https://shovon.bd/blog/chittagong-commute-time-map — Live: https://maps01.shovon.bd/
- Interactive driving isochrone map of Chittagong (Chattogram): click or drag a pin to see areas reachable in 10/20/30/40/50/60 minutes.
- Mapbox Isochrone API (two parallel requests, since the API allows max 4 contours per call), Mapbox GL JS v3 style expressions for the colour ramp and a Roads mode using `within`, Turf.js booleanPointInPolygon for hover tooltips, Next.js + TypeScript + Tailwind, no backend.

## Security Research & Vulnerability Disclosures (CVEs)

### CVE-2026-15151 — Five Star Restaurant Reservations Missing Authorization
- **Title**: Five Star Restaurant Reservations < 2.7.23 — Booking Manager+ Missing Authorization via rtb_reset_notifications
- **Plugin**: Five Star Restaurant Reservations (WordPress Plugin)
- **Vulnerability Class**: Improper Access Control / Missing Authorization (CWE-284)
- **Affected Versions**: < 2.7.23
- **Patched Version**: 2.7.23
- **CVSS Score**: 3.8 (Low)
- **Researcher**: Md Minaruzzaman Shovon
- **Disclosed**: July 20, 2026
- **Summary**: The Five Star Restaurant Reservations plugin before 2.7.23 does not perform a capability check on one of its AJAX actions, allowing users with the lowest booking-management role (which by default cannot access the plugin's settings) to reset the site's configured booking notification rules.
- **WPScan Reference**: https://wpscan.com/vulnerability/2c28e8b9-4293-4cf4-990d-09727275935b/
- **CVE Reference**: https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-15151
- **Advisory URL**: https://shovon.bd/security/cve-2026-15151

### CVE-2026-15048 — GeekyBot Unauthenticated Sensitive Information Exposure
- **Title**: GeekyBot < 1.2.8 — Unauthenticated Sensitive Information Exposure via Chat History
- **Plugin**: GeekyBot (WordPress Plugin)
- **Vulnerability Class**: Sensitive Information Exposure (CWE-200)
- **Affected Versions**: < 1.2.8
- **Patched Version**: 1.2.8
- **CVSS Score**: 5.3 (Medium)
- **Researcher**: Md Minaruzzaman Shovon
- **Disclosed**: July 31, 2026
- **Summary**: The GeekyBot plugin before 1.2.8 does not perform an authorization check on one of its AJAX actions, allowing unauthenticated users to retrieve chat-history session metadata including WordPress usernames, user IDs, and timestamps.
- **WPScan Reference**: https://wpscan.com/vulnerability/881d1548-e6c3-4093-ab8c-dc3a9fcccc34/
- **CVE Reference**: https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-15048
- **Advisory URL**: https://shovon.bd/security/cve-2026-15048

### CVE-2026-14322 — Timetics Unauthenticated Booking Auto-Approval
- **Title**: Timetics < 1.0.57 — Unauthenticated Booking Auto-Approval via Arbitrary payment_method
- **Plugin**: Timetics (WordPress Plugin)
- **Vulnerability Class**: Broken Access Control / Access Controls (CWE-284)
- **Affected Versions**: < 1.0.57
- **Patched Version**: 1.0.57
- **CVSS Score**: 5.3 (Medium)
- **CVSS Vector**: CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:L/A:N
- **Researcher**: Md Minaruzzaman Shovon
- **Disclosed**: July 2026
- **Summary**: The Timetics plugin failed to validate payment completion or enforce unpaid status for bookings created via unrecognised or custom `payment_method` strings (e.g. `paypal`). An unauthenticated attacker sending a POST request to `/wp-json/timetics/v1/bookings` with `status: "approved"` could generate fully approved bookings for paid appointments without making any payment.
- **WPScan Reference**: https://wpscan.com/vulnerability/0fb14dca-d4aa-4c24-bf15-37099edb7614/
- **CVE Reference**: https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-14322
- **Advisory URL**: https://shovon.bd/security/cve-2026-14322

### CVE-2026-10749 — Post Duplicator PHP Object Injection
- **Title**: Post Duplicator <= 3.0.14 — PHP Object Injection
- **Plugin**: Post Duplicator (WordPress Plugin)
- **Vulnerability Class**: PHP Object Injection / Deserialization of Untrusted Data (CWE-502)
- **Affected Versions**: <= 3.0.14
- **Patched Version**: 3.0.15
- **CVSS Score**: 7.2 (High)
- **CVSS Vector**: CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:H/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H
- **Researcher**: Md Minaruzzaman Shovon
- **Disclosed**: June 2026
- **Summary**: The plugin passed user-supplied input to PHP's unsafe `unserialize()` function via the `customMetaData` parameter. Authenticated users with Contributor role or higher could inject serialized PHP objects, leading to Remote Code Execution (RCE) when suitable gadget chains exist.
- **CVE Reference**: https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-10749
- **WPScan Reference**: https://wpscan.com/vulnerability/224c36b5-e604-4eb3-aad8-47283b95e994/
- **Advisory URL**: https://shovon.bd/security/cve-2026-10749

### CVE-2026-57661 — WPComplete Broken Access Control
- **Title**: WPComplete <= 2.9.5.5 — Broken Access Control
- **Plugin**: WPComplete (WordPress Plugin)
- **Vulnerability Class**: Broken Access Control / Missing Authorization (CWE-862)
- **Affected Versions**: <= 2.9.5.5
- **Patched Version**: 2.9.5.6
- **CVSS Score**: 5.4 (Medium)
- **CVSS Vector**: CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:L/A:N
- **Researcher**: Md Minaruzzaman Shovon
- **Disclosed**: June 2026
- **Summary**: WPComplete suffered from missing authorization checks and missing nonce validation, enabling Subscriber-level users to invoke privileged functions and tamper with course completion status for arbitrary users.
- **CVE Reference**: https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-57661
- **Advisory URL**: https://shovon.bd/security/cve-2026-57661

### CVE-2026-14821 — Quiz and Survey Master Missing Authorization
- **Title**: Quiz and Survey Master < 11.1.5 — Missing Authorization on Output Template Deletion
- **Plugin**: Quiz and Survey Master (QSM) (WordPress Plugin)
- **Vulnerability Class**: Missing Authorization (CWE-862)
- **Affected Versions**: < 11.1.5
- **Patched Version**: 11.1.5
- **CVSS Score**: 2.7 (Low)
- **Researcher**: Md Minaruzzaman Shovon
- **Disclosed**: May 2026
- **Summary**: Missing authorization checks in Quiz and Survey Master < 11.1.5 allow authenticated users with Contributor-level access or higher to delete arbitrary output templates, disrupting quiz functionality.
- **CVE Reference**: https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-14821
- **Advisory URL**: https://shovon.bd/security/cve-2026-14821

### MapPress Maps for WordPress 2.97.2 — Security Assistance Recognition
- **Plugin**: MapPress Maps for WordPress (MapPress Google Maps for WordPress)
- **Version**: 2.97.2
- **Researcher**: Md Minaruzzaman Shovon
- **Changelog Credit**: "Thanks to https://shovon.bd for security assistance in 2.97"
- **Reference**: https://wordpress.org/plugins/mappress-google-maps-for-wordpress/#developers
